system.longDesc:
Rarity: Uncommon.

A foot-long metallic rod that contains a powerful capacitor and the ability to discharge a bolt of electricity when a button on its side is depressed. The rod’s wielder uses a major action to make an Accuracy (Pistols) attack roll against a target within 20 yards. A successful attack inflicts 2d6 penetrating electricity damage. A lightning rod stores 15 power points, and each bolt fired drains 3 power points. It can be recharged in an hour with a source of electrical current.
